import torch
import tilelang
import tilelang.language as T


_KERNEL_CACHE = {}
_WORKSPACE_CACHE_KEY = None
_WORKSPACE_CACHE_VALUE = None
_WEIGHT_CACHE = {}
_EXPERT_BLOCK_M = 192


@tilelang.jit(
    pass_configs={
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_WARP_SPECIALIZED: True,
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_SAFE_MEMORY_ACCESS: True,
    }
)
def _pack_experts_kernel(
    hidden,
    num_experts,
    total_padded_tokens,
    expert_block_m,
):
    block_n = 256
    threads = 256
    packed_shape = (num_experts, expert_block_m, hidden)

    @T.prim_func
    def kernel(
        stacked_expert_tokens: T.Tensor((total_padded_tokens, hidden), T.float16),
        group_sizes: T.Tensor((num_experts,), T.int32),
        group_padded_offsets: T.Tensor((num_experts + 1,), T.int32),
        packed_input: T.Tensor(packed_shape, T.float16),
    ):
        with T.Kernel(
            num_experts,
            T.ceildiv(hidden, block_n),
            threads=threads,
        ) as (expert_id, bn):
            group_size = group_sizes[expert_id]
            padded_start = group_padded_offsets[expert_id]
            for i, j in T.Parallel(expert_block_m, block_n):
                if i < group_size:
                    packed_input[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j] = (
                        stacked_expert_tokens[padded_start + i, bn * block_n + j]
                    )

    return kernel


@tilelang.jit(
    pass_configs={
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_WARP_SPECIALIZED: True,
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_SAFE_MEMORY_ACCESS: True,
    }
)
def _unpack_experts_kernel(
    hidden,
    num_experts,
    total_padded_tokens,
    total_valid_tokens,
    expert_block_m,
    expert_start,
    expert_chunk,
):
    block_n = 256
    threads = 256
    packed_shape = (expert_chunk, expert_block_m, hidden)

    @T.prim_func
    def kernel(
        packed_output: T.Tensor(packed_shape, T.float16),
        routed_expert_weights: T.Tensor((total_valid_tokens,), T.float32),
        group_sizes: T.Tensor((num_experts,), T.int32),
        group_offsets: T.Tensor((num_experts + 1,), T.int32),
        group_padded_offsets: T.Tensor((num_experts + 1,), T.int32),
        out: T.Tensor((total_padded_tokens, hidden), T.float16),
    ):
        with T.Kernel(
            expert_chunk,
            T.ceildiv(hidden, block_n),
            threads=threads,
        ) as (local_expert_id, bn):
            expert_id = expert_start + local_expert_id
            group_size = group_sizes[expert_id]
            raw_start = group_offsets[expert_id]
            padded_start = group_padded_offsets[expert_id]
            for i, j in T.Parallel(expert_block_m, block_n):
                if i < group_size:
                    out[padded_start + i, bn * block_n + j] = (
                        packed_output[local_expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j]
                        * routed_expert_weights[raw_start + i]
                    )

    return kernel


@tilelang.jit(
    pass_configs={
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_WARP_SPECIALIZED: True,
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_SAFE_MEMORY_ACCESS: True,
    }

@tilelang.jit(
    pass_configs={
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_WARP_SPECIALIZED: True,
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_SAFE_MEMORY_ACCESS: True,
    }
)
def _grouped_e64_fc2_kernel(hidden, total_padded_tokens, total_valid_tokens):
    block_token = 64
    block_dexpert = 64
    block_dhidden = 128
    threads = 256
    num_stages = 2
    num_experts = 64
    expert_block_m = 192
    max_m_blocks = (num_experts * expert_block_m + block_token - 1) // block_token

    @T.prim_func
    def kernel(
        activation: T.Tensor((num_experts, expert_block_m, 2048), T.float16),
        down_w: T.Tensor((num_experts, hidden, 2048), T.float16),
        routed_expert_weights: T.Tensor((total_valid_tokens,), T.float32),
        group_sizes: T.Tensor((num_experts,), T.int32),
        group_offsets: T.Tensor((num_experts + 1,), T.int32),
        group_padded_offsets: T.Tensor((num_experts + 1,), T.int32),
        out: T.Tensor((total_padded_tokens, hidden), T.float16),
    ):
        with T.Kernel(max_m_blocks, T.ceildiv(hidden, block_dhidden), threads=threads) as (bx, by):
            m_start_padded = bx * block_token
            cur_expert = 0
            for i in T.serial(num_experts):
                if m_start_padded >= group_padded_offsets[i]:
                    cur_expert = i
            row_base = m_start_padded - group_padded_offsets[cur_expert]
            raw_base = group_offsets[cur_expert] + row_base
            actual_rows = T.max(0, T.min(block_token, group_sizes[cur_expert] - row_base))
            input_shared = T.alloc_shared((block_token, block_dexpert), T.float16)
            weight_shared = T.alloc_shared((block_dhidden, block_dexpert), T.float16)
            output_local = T.alloc_fragment((block_token, block_dhidden), T.float32)
            T.clear(output_local)
            for k in T.Pipelined(T.ceildiv(2048, block_dexpert), num_stages=num_stages):
                T.copy(activation[cur_expert, row_base:row_base + block_token, k * block_dexpert:(k + 1) * block_dexpert], input_shared)
                T.copy(down_w[cur_expert, by * block_dhidden:(by + 1) * block_dhidden, k * block_dexpert:(k + 1) * block_dexpert], weight_shared)
                T.gemm(input_shared, weight_shared, output_local, transpose_B=True)
            for i, j in T.Parallel(block_token, block_dhidden):
                if i < actual_rows:
                    out[group_padded_offsets[cur_expert] + row_base + i, by * block_dhidden + j] = output_local[i, j] * routed_expert_weights[raw_base + i]

    return kernel

def _swiglu_kernel(
    intermediate,
    num_experts,
    expert_block_m,
):
    block_n = 256
    threads = 256
    shape = (num_experts, expert_block_m, intermediate)

    @T.prim_func
    def kernel(
        gate_output: T.Tensor(shape, T.float16),
        up_output: T.Tensor(shape, T.float16),
        group_sizes: T.Tensor((num_experts,), T.int32),
        activation: T.Tensor(shape, T.float16),
    ):
        with T.Kernel(
            num_experts,
            T.ceildiv(intermediate, block_n),
            threads=threads,
        ) as (expert_id, bn):
            group_size = group_sizes[expert_id]
            for i, j in T.Parallel(expert_block_m, block_n):
                if i < group_size:
                    gate = gate_output[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j]
                    activation[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j] = (
                        gate
                        * T.sigmoid(gate)
                        * up_output[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j]
                    )

    return kernel


@tilelang.jit(
    pass_configs={
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_WARP_SPECIALIZED: True,
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_SAFE_MEMORY_ACCESS: True,
    }
)
def _combine_fc1_weights_kernel(
    hidden,
    intermediate,
    num_experts,
):
    block_i = 64
    block_h = 256
    threads = 256

    @T.prim_func
    def kernel(
        gate_w: T.Tensor((num_experts, intermediate, hidden), T.float16),
        up_w: T.Tensor((num_experts, intermediate, hidden), T.float16),
        combined_w: T.Tensor((num_experts, intermediate * 2, hidden), T.float16),
    ):
        with T.Kernel(
            num_experts,
            T.ceildiv(intermediate * 2, block_i),
            T.ceildiv(hidden, block_h),
            threads=threads,
        ) as (expert_id, bi, bh):
            for i, j in T.Parallel(block_i, block_h):
                row = bi * block_i + i
                col = bh * block_h + j
                if row < intermediate:
                    combined_w[expert_id, row, col] = gate_w[expert_id, row, col]
                else:
                    combined_w[expert_id, row, col] = up_w[
                        expert_id, row - intermediate, col
                    ]

    return kernel

+        group_offsets: T.Tensor((num_experts + 1,), T.int32),
+        group_padded_offsets: T.Tensor((num_experts + 1,), T.int32),
+        out: T.Tensor((total_padded_tokens, hidden), T.float16),
+    ):
+        with T.Kernel(max_m_blocks, T.ceildiv(hidden, block_dhidden), threads=threads) as (bx, by):
+            m_start_padded = bx * block_token
+            cur_expert = 0
+            for i in T.serial(num_experts):
+                if m_start_padded >= group_padded_offsets[i]:
+                    cur_expert = i
+            row_base = m_start_padded - group_padded_offsets[cur_expert]
+            raw_base = group_offsets[cur_expert] + row_base
+            actual_rows = T.max(0, T.min(block_token, group_sizes[cur_expert] - row_base))
+            input_shared = T.alloc_shared((block_token, block_dexpert), T.float16)
+            weight_shared = T.alloc_shared((block_dhidden, block_dexpert), T.float16)
+            output_local = T.alloc_fragment((block_token, block_dhidden), T.float32)
+            T.clear(output_local)
+            for k in T.Pipelined(T.ceildiv(2048, block_dexpert), num_stages=num_stages):
+                T.copy(activation[cur_expert, row_base:row_base + block_token, k * block_dexpert:(k + 1) * block_dexpert], input_shared)
+                T.copy(down_w[cur_expert, by * block_dhidden:(by + 1) * block_dhidden, k * block_dexpert:(k + 1) * block_dexpert], weight_shared)
+                T.gemm(input_shared, weight_shared, output_local, transpose_B=True)
+            for i, j in T.Parallel(block_token, block_dhidden):
+                if i < actual_rows:
+                    out[group_padded_offsets[cur_expert] + row_base + i, by * block_dhidden + j] = output_local[i, j] * routed_expert_weights[raw_base + i]
+
+    return kernel

            else None
        )

def _get_combined_fc1_weight(gate_w, up_w, combine_weights):
    key = (
        int(gate_w.device.index or 0),
        int(gate_w.shape[0]),
        int(gate_w.shape[1]),
        int(gate_w.shape[2]),
        str(gate_w.dtype),
    )
    cached = _WEIGHT_CACHE.get(key)
    if cached is None or cached[0] is not gate_w or cached[1] is not up_w:
        combined_w = torch.empty(
            (gate_w.shape[0], gate_w.shape[1] * 2, gate_w.shape[2]),
            device=gate_w.device,
            dtype=gate_w.dtype,
        )
        combine_weights(gate_w, up_w, combined_w)
        cached = (gate_w, up_w, combined_w)
        _WEIGHT_CACHE[key] = cached
    return cached[2]

def _unpack_e64_four_chunks_kernel(hidden, total_padded_tokens, total_valid_tokens, expert_block_m):
    block_n = 256
    threads = 256

    @T.prim_func
    def kernel(
        output0: T.Tensor((16, expert_block_m, hidden), T.float16),
        output1: T.Tensor((16, expert_block_m, hidden), T.float16),
        output2: T.Tensor((16, expert_block_m, hidden), T.float16),
        output3: T.Tensor((16, expert_block_m, hidden), T.float16),
        routed_expert_weights: T.Tensor((total_valid_tokens,), T.float32),
        group_sizes: T.Tensor((64,), T.int32),
        group_offsets: T.Tensor((65,), T.int32),
        group_padded_offsets: T.Tensor((65,), T.int32),
        out: T.Tensor((total_padded_tokens, hidden), T.float16),
    ):
        with T.Kernel(4, 16, T.ceildiv(hidden, block_n), threads=threads) as (chunk_id, local_expert_id, bn):
            expert_id = chunk_id * 16 + local_expert_id
            group_size = group_sizes[expert_id]
            raw_start = group_offsets[expert_id]
            padded_start = group_padded_offsets[expert_id]
            for i, j in T.Parallel(expert_block_m, block_n):
                if i < group_size:
                    if chunk_id == 0:
                        value = output0[local_expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j]
                    elif chunk_id == 1:
                        value = output1[local_expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j]
                    elif chunk_id == 2:
                        value = output2[local_expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j]
                    else:
                        value = output3[local_expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j]
                    out[padded_start + i, bn * block_n + j] = value * routed_expert_weights[raw_start + i]

    return kernel

def _swiglu_kernel(
    intermediate,
    num_experts,
    expert_block_m,
):
    block_n = 256
    threads = 256
    shape = (num_experts, expert_block_m, intermediate)

    @T.prim_func
    def kernel(
        gate_output: T.Tensor(shape, T.float16),
        up_output: T.Tensor(shape, T.float16),
        group_sizes: T.Tensor((num_experts,), T.int32),
        activation: T.Tensor(shape, T.float16),
    ):
        with T.Kernel(
            num_experts,
            T.ceildiv(intermediate, block_n),
            threads=threads,
        ) as (expert_id, bn):
            group_size = group_sizes[expert_id]
            for i, j in T.Parallel(expert_block_m, block_n):
                if i < group_size:
                    gate = gate_output[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j]
                    activation[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j] = (
                        gate
                        * T.sigmoid(gate)
                        * up_output[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j]
                    )

    return kernel

def _combine_fc1_weights_kernel(
    hidden,
    intermediate,
    num_experts,
):
    block_i = 64
    block_h = 256
    threads = 256

    @T.prim_func
    def kernel(
        gate_w: T.Tensor((num_experts, intermediate, hidden), T.float16),
        up_w: T.Tensor((num_experts, intermediate, hidden), T.float16),
        combined_w: T.Tensor((num_experts, intermediate * 2, hidden), T.float16),
    ):
        with T.Kernel(
            num_experts,
            T.ceildiv(intermediate * 2, block_i),
            T.ceildiv(hidden, block_h),
            threads=threads,
        ) as (expert_id, bi, bh):
            for i, j in T.Parallel(block_i, block_h):
                row = bi * block_i + i
                col = bh * block_h + j
                if row < intermediate:
                    combined_w[expert_id, row, col] = gate_w[expert_id, row, col]
                else:
                    combined_w[expert_id, row, col] = up_w[
                        expert_id, row - intermediate, col
                    ]

    return kernel

def _unpack_split_experts_kernel(
    hidden,
    num_experts,
    total_padded_tokens,
    total_valid_tokens,
    split_m,
    row_base,
):
    block_n = 256
    threads = 256

    @T.prim_func
    def kernel(
        split_output: T.Tensor((num_experts, split_m, hidden), T.float16),
        routed_expert_weights: T.Tensor((total_valid_tokens,), T.float32),
        group_sizes: T.Tensor((num_experts,), T.int32),
        group_offsets: T.Tensor((num_experts + 1,), T.int32),
        group_padded_offsets: T.Tensor((num_experts + 1,), T.int32),
        out: T.Tensor((total_padded_tokens, hidden), T.float16),
    ):
        with T.Kernel(
            num_experts,
            T.ceildiv(hidden, block_n),
            threads=threads,
        ) as (expert_id, bn):
            group_size = group_sizes[expert_id]
            raw_start = group_offsets[expert_id]
            padded_start = group_padded_offsets[expert_id]
            for i, j in T.Parallel(split_m, block_n):
                global_i = row_base + i
                if global_i < group_size:
                    out[padded_start + global_i, bn * block_n + j] = (
                        split_output[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j]
                        * routed_expert_weights[raw_start + global_i]
                    )

    return kernel

                        cur_group_idx, by * block_dexpert : (by + 1) * block_dexpert, k * block_dhidden : (k + 1) * block_dhidden
                    ],
                    routed_expert_up_shared,
                )
                T.gemm(input_shared, routed_expert_up_shared, up_logits_local, transpose_B=True)

            for i, j in T.Parallel(block_token, block_dexpert):
                gate_logits_local[i, j] = gate_logits_local[i, j] * (1.0 / (1.0 + T.exp2(-gate_logits_local[i, j] * scale)))
                up_logits_local[i, j] = up_logits_local[i, j] * gate_logits_local[i, j]

            for i, j in T.Parallel(block_token, block_dexpert):
                if i < actual_rows:
                    up_logits[m_start + i, by * block_dexpert + j] = up_logits_local[i, j]

        # Step 2: Compute down logits
        with T.Kernel(M, T.ceildiv(dhidden, block_dhidden), threads=threads) as (bx, by):
            up_logits_shared = T.alloc_fragment((block_token, block_dexpert), dtype=dtype)
            routed_expert_down_shared = T.alloc_shared((block_dhidden, block_dexpert), dtype=dtype)
            output_local = T.alloc_fragment((block_token, block_dhidden), dtype=accum_dtype)

            T.use_swizzle(10)

            actual_rows = T.max(0, T.min(block_token, cur_group_size - (m_start_padded - group_padded_offsets[cur_group_idx])))

            T.clear(output_local)

            for k in T.Pipelined(T.ceildiv(dexpert, block_dexpert), num_stages=num_stages):
                T.copy(
                    up_logits[m_start : m_start + block_token, k * block_dexpert : (k + 1) * block_dexpert],
                    up_logits_shared,
                )

                    ],
                    routed_expert_down_shared,
                )
                T.gemm(up_logits_shared, routed_expert_down_shared, output_local, transpose_B=True)

                if i < actual_rows:
                    output[m_start + i, by * block_dhidden + j] = output_local[i, j] * routed_expert_weights[m_start + i]

def _pack_experts_kernel(
    hidden,
    num_experts,
    total_padded_tokens,
    expert_block_m,
):
    block_n = 256
    threads = 256
    packed_shape = (num_experts, expert_block_m, hidden)

    @T.prim_func
    def kernel(
        stacked_expert_tokens: T.Tensor((total_padded_tokens, hidden), T.float16),
        group_sizes: T.Tensor((num_experts,), T.int32),
        group_padded_offsets: T.Tensor((num_experts + 1,), T.int32),
        packed_input: T.Tensor(packed_shape, T.float16),
    ):
        with T.Kernel(
            num_experts,
            T.ceildiv(hidden, block_n),
            threads=threads,
        ) as (expert_id, bn):
            group_size = group_sizes[expert_id]
            padded_start = group_padded_offsets[expert_id]
            for i, j in T.Parallel(expert_block_m, block_n):
                if i < group_size:
                    packed_input[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j] = (
                        stacked_expert_tokens[padded_start + i, bn * block_n + j]
                    )

    return kernel

up_logits = torch.matmul(x_e, up_f32[expert_idx].transpose(0, 1))\n        hidden_act = torch.sigmoid(gate_logits) * gate_logits * up_logits\n        y_e = torch.matmul(hidden_act, routed_expert_weights: torch.Tensor,\n    group_sizes: torch.Tensor,\n    group_offsets: torch.Tensor,\n    group_padded_offsets: torch.Tensor,\n    group_idx_for_bx: torch.Tensor,\n    out: torch.Tensor,\n) -> None:\n    out.zero_()\n    num_experts = int(group_sizes.numel())\n\n    x_f32 = stacked_expert_tokens.to(torch.float32)\n    gate_f32 = gate_w.to(torch.float32)\n    up_f32 = up_w.to(torch.float32)\n    down_f32 = down_w.to(torch.float32)\n\n    for expert_idx in range(num_experts):\n        valid_count = int(group_sizes[expert_idx].item())\n        if valid_count == 0:\n            continue\n\n        raw_start = int(group_offsets[expert_idx].item())\n        padded_start = int(group_padded_offsets[expert_idx].item())\n\n        x_e = x_f32[padded_start:padded_start + valid_count]\n        gate_logits = torch.matmul(x_e, gate_f32[expert_idx].transpose(0, 1))\n        up_logits = torch.matmul(x_e, up_f32[expert_idx].transpose(0, 1))\n        hidden_act = torch.sigmoid(gate_logits) * gate_logits * up_logits\n        y_e = torch.matmul(hidden_act, down_f32[expert_idx].transpose(0, 1))\n        y_e *= routed_expert_weights[raw_start:raw_start + valid_count].to(torch.float32).unsqueeze(1)\n\n        out[padded_start:padded_start + valid_count].copy_(y_e.to(torch.float16))\n```\n\n杩欎唤鍙傝€冨疄鐜板搴旂殑鏁板璇箟鏄細\n\n```text\nfor each expert e:\n    x_e       = hidden @ down_w[e]^T\n    y_e        *= routed_expert_weights[raw_start : raw_start + valid_count]\n\n    out[padded_start : padded_start + valid_count] = y_e\n```\n\n鍏朵腑锛歕n\n- `raw_start = group_offsets[e]`\n- `padded_start = group_padded_offsets[e]`\n- `valid_count = group_sizes[e]`\n\n瀹炵幇瑕佺偣锛歕n\n**璇ラ鐩殑 GPU 璁＄畻绠楀瓙涓嶈兘浣跨敤 PyTorch锛岃鍙敤 TileLang 瀹屾垚鐩稿叧璁＄畻绠楀瓙銆?*  \n\n1. `group_offsets` @tilelang.jit(
    pass_configs={
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_WARP_SPECIALIZED: True,
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_SAFE_MEMORY_ACCESS: True,
    }

def _grouped_e64_fc2_kernel(hidden, total_padded_tokens, total_valid_tokens):
    block_token = 64
    block_dexpert = 64
    block_dhidden = 128
    threads = 256
    num_stages = 2
    num_experts = 64
    expert_block_m = 192
    max_m_blocks = (num_experts * expert_block_m + block_token - 1) // block_token

    @T.prim_func
    def kernel(
        activation: T.Tensor((num_experts, expert_block_m, 2048), T.float16),
        down_w: T.Tensor((num_experts, hidden, 2048), T.float16),
        routed_expert_weights: T.Tensor((total_valid_tokens,), T.float32),
        group_sizes: T.Tensor((num_experts,), T.int32),
        group_offsets: T.Tensor((num_experts + 1,), T.int32),
        group_padded_offsets: T.Tensor((num_experts + 1,), T.int32),
        out: T.Tensor((total_padded_tokens, hidden), T.float16),
    ):
        with T.Kernel(max_m_blocks, T.ceildiv(hidden, block_dhidden), threads=threads) as (bx, by):
            m_start_padded = bx * block_token
            cur_expert = 0
            for i in T.serial(num_experts):
                if m_start_padded >= group_padded_offsets[i]:
                    cur_expert = i
            row_base = m_start_padded - group_padded_offsets[cur_expert]
            raw_base = group_offsets[cur_expert] + row_base
            actual_rows = T.max(0, T.min(block_token, group_sizes[cur_expert] - row_base))
            input_shared = T.alloc_shared((block_token, block_dexpert), T.float16)
            weight_shared = T.alloc_shared((block_dhidden, block_dexpert), T.float16)
            output_local = T.alloc_fragment((block_token, block_dhidden), T.float32)
            T.clear(output_local)
            for k in T.Pipelined(T.ceildiv(2048, block_dexpert), num_stages=num_stages):
                T.copy(activation[cur_expert, row_base:row_base + block_token, k * block_dexpert:(k + 1) * block_dexpert], input_shared)
                T.copy(down_w[cur_expert, by * block_dhidden:(by + 1) * block_dhidden, k * block_dexpert:(k + 1) * block_dexpert], weight_shared)
                T.gemm(input_shared, weight_shared, output_local, transpose_B=True)
            for i, j in T.Parallel(block_token, block_dhidden):
                if i < actual_rows:
                    out[group_padded_offsets[cur_expert] + row_base + i, by * block_dhidden + j] = output_local[i, j] * routed_expert_weights[raw_base + i]

    return kernel

        activation: T.Tensor(shape, T.float16),

torch.sigmoid(gate_logits) * gate_logits * up_logits\n        y_e = torch.matmul(hidden_act, down_f32[expert_idx].transpose(0, 1))\n        y_e *= routed_expert_weights[raw_start:raw_start + valid_count].to(torch.float32).unsqueeze(1)\n\n        out[padded_start:padded_start + valid_count].copy_(y_e.to(torch.float16))\n```\n\n这份参考实现对应的数学语义是：\n\n```text\nfor each expert e:\n    x_e = stacked_expert_tokens[padded_start : padded_start + valid_count]\n\n    gate_logits = x_e @ gate_w[e]^T\n    up_logits   = x_e @ up_w[e]^T\n    hidden      = silu(gate_logits) * up_logits\n    y_e         = hidden @ down_w[e]^T\n    y_e        *= routed_expert_weights[raw_start : raw_start + valid_count]\n\n    out[padded_start : padded_start + valid_count] = y_e\n```\n\n其中：\n\n- `raw_start = group_offsets[e]`\n- `padded_start = group_padded_offsets[e]`\n- `valid_count = group_sizes[e]`\n\n实现要点：\n\n**该题目的 GPU 计算算子不能使用 PyTorch，请只用 TileLang 完成相关计算算子。**  \n\n1. `group_offsets` 和 `group_padded_offsets` 需要分别使用，不能混用。\n2. `routed_expert_weights` 的索引基于真实 token 顺序。\n3. `stacked_expert_tokens` 与 `out` 的索引基于 padding 后顺序。\n4. padding 行不参与计算，输出保持为 `0`。\n5. 当前 baseline 主路径会把 `group_idx_for_bx` 用作 block 到 expert group 的映射。\n6. 为了对齐 TileLang kernel 的常见实现，最终结果按 `float16` 写回。\n\n"

+def _grouped_e64_fc2_kernel(hidden, total_padded_tokens, total_valid_tokens):
+    block_token = 64
+    block_dexpert = 64
+    block_dhidden = 128
+    threads = 256
+    num_stages = 2
+    num_experts = 64
+    expert_block_m = 192
+    max_m_blocks = (num_experts * expert_block_m + block_token - 1) // block_token
+
+    @T.prim_func
+    def kernel(
+        activation: T.Tensor((num_experts, expert_block_m, 2048), T.float16),
+        down_w: T.Tensor((num_experts, hidden, 2048), T.float16),
+        routed_expert_weights: T.Tensor((total_valid_tokens,), T.float32),
+        group_sizes: T.Tensor((num_experts,), T.int32),
+        group_offsets: T.Tensor((num_experts + 1,), T.int32),
+        group_padded_offsets: T.Tensor((num_experts + 1,), T.int32),
+        out: T.Tensor((total_padded_tokens, hidden), T.float16),
+    ):
+        with T.Kernel(max_m_blocks, T.ceildiv(hidden, block_dhidden), threads=threads) as (bx, by):
+            m_start_padded = bx * block_token
+            cur_expert = 0
+            for i in T.serial(num_experts):
+                if m_start_padded >= group_padded_offsets[i]:
+                    cur_expert = i
+            row_base = m_start_padded - group_padded_offsets[cur_expert]
+            raw_base = group_offsets[cur_expert] + row_base
+            actual_rows = T.max(0, T.min(block_token, group_sizes[cur_expert] - row_base))
+            input_shared = T.alloc_shared((block_token, block_dexpert), T.float16)
+            weight_shared = T.alloc_shared((block_dhidden, block_dexpert), T.float16)
+            output_local = T.alloc_fragment((block_token, block_dhidden), T.float32)
+            T.clear(output_local)
+            for k in T.Pipelined(T.ceildiv(2048, block_dexpert), num_stages=num_stages):
+                T.copy(activation[cur_expert, row_base:row_base + block_token, k * block_dexpert:(k + 1) * block_dexpert], input_shared)
+                T.copy(down_w[cur_expert, by * block_dhidden:(by + 1) * block_dhidden, k * block_dexpert:(k + 1) * block_dexpert], weight_shared)
+                T.gemm(input_shared, weight_shared, output_local, transpose_B=True)
+            for i, j in T.Parallel(block_token, block_dhidden):
+                if i < actual_rows:
+                    out[group_padded_offsets[cur_expert] + row_base + i, by * block_dhidden + j] = output_local[i, j] * routed_expert_weights[raw_base + i]
+
+    return kernel
